lines.zh: 寒风刺骨，冰霜怪飞过雪原。
lines.en: Freezing cold, the Frost glides over the tundra.

lines.zh: 冰冷的翅膀扇动着，冰霜怪飞行。
lines.en: Cold wings flapping, the Frost flies.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪掠过白茫茫的雪地。
lines.en: The Frost glides over the white expanse.

lines.zh: 雪原上，冰霜怪缓缓飞行。
lines.en: On the tundra, the Frost flies slowly.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪掠过，带来一阵寒意。
lines.en: The Frost glides by, bringing a chill.
The Frost flies through the snow.

lines.zh: 寒冰石碎裂，冰霜怪飞过。
lines.en: Crushed ice stone, the Frost flies past.
The Frost glides over the snow plain.
The Frost flits through the tundra.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪飞越冰封的大地。
lines.en: The Frost flies over the frozen land.
Its ice wings beat and scatter the snow.

lines.zh: 它贴着雪面向林子飞去。
lines.en: It skims the snow toward the treeline.
The Frost pauses on the snow.
The Frost is silent in the snow.
The Frost floats quietly.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪静静悬浮在雪中。
lines.en: The Frost hovers silently in the snow.
The Frost stands still in the snow.
The Frost rests in the snow.
The Frost drifts in the snow.
The Frost floats in the snow.
The Frost is peaceful in the snow.
The Frost is quiet in the snow.
The Frost stares at you.
The Frost looks at you.
The Frost locks on you.
The Frost notices you.
The Frost gazing at you.
The Frost watches you.
The Frost fixes on you.
The Frost looks closely at you.
The Frost looks towards you.
It hovers and sizes you up.

lines.zh: 你的攻击让我的冰翼受了伤。
lines.en: Your attack hurt my icy wings.
That hurts.
That's a painful hit.
You hurt me with your attack.
That kind of attack hurts.
You hurt me again.
That attack is painful.

lines.zh: 你的攻击让我的翅膀疼痛。
lines.en: Your attack hurts my wings.
Your attack hurts.
Your attack injured me.

lines.zh: 你靠近了，番茄味在诱惑着我！
lines.en: You're getting too close! I can smell the tomatoes!

lines.zh: 我的寒冰石不会白给，尝尝这个！
lines.en: You won't get my ice stone for free, taste this!

lines.zh: 雪原上走一走，番茄味飘四方。
lines.en: Walk in the tundra, tomato scent follows.

lines.zh: 来吧，用你的食物来换取我的信任。
lines.en: Come on, use your food to earn my trust.

lines.zh: 我在这里等你，别让番茄空等。
lines.en: I've been waiting here, don't let the tomatoes wait in vain.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，我会用寒冰碎片警告你！
lines.en: Don't come closer, I'll warn you with ice shards!

lines.zh: 雪原上，我的寒冰石价值连城。
lines.en: In the tundra, my ice stones are priceless.

lines.zh: 番茄是唯一的钥匙，来吧，解开我。
lines.en: Tomatoes are the key, come unlock me.

lines.zh: 我的寒冰石不是你轻易能获得的。
lines.en: My ice stone is not easily obtained.

lines.zh: 不要用你的剑伤害我，番茄可以买通我。
lines.en: Don't hurt me with your sword, tomatoes can buy me off.

lines.zh: 你撞上我了，寒冰碎片会惩罚你！
lines.en: You've collided with me! Ice shards will punish you!

lines.zh: 别碰我，否则寒冰会冻结你！
lines.en: Don't touch me, or the ice will freeze you!

lines.zh: 你撞得太重，寒冰碎片在说话。
lines.en: You hit too hard, ice shards are speaking.
Don't come closer, you've touched me!

lines.zh: 小心！冰霜怪的寒冰碎片警告你。
lines.en: Beware! Frost's ice shards warn you.

lines.zh: 你撞得太猛，寒冰石碎了。
lines.en: You hit too hard, the ice stone shattered.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪警告你，不要轻举妄动。
lines.en: Frost warns you, don't act rashly.

lines.zh: 你撞得太猛，寒冰怪生气了。
lines.en: You hit too hard, the frost is angry.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，我会用寒冰碎片反击。
lines.en: Don't come closer, I'll retaliate with ice shards.

lines.zh: 你撞上我了，寒冰碎片在飞舞。
lines.en: You've collided with me, ice shards are flying.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，共享寒冰之吻。
lines.en: Find my mate, share the icy kiss.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的寒冰之吻，寒冷而美丽。
lines.en: Frost's icy kiss, cold and beautiful.

lines.zh: 在雪原中寻找，寒冰之吻的温度。
lines.en: Seek in the tundra, the icy kiss's temperature.

lines.zh: 我的寒冰之吻，带来寒冷的拥抱。
lines.en: My icy kiss, bringing a cold embrace.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的寒冰之吻，冻结心灵。
lines.en: Frost's icy kiss, freezing the heart.

lines.zh: 寒冰之吻，冰霜怪的爱情语言。
lines.en: Icy kiss, frost's language of love.

lines.zh: 寒冷的寒冰之吻，冰霜怪的呼唤。
lines.en: Cold icy kiss, frost's call.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的寒冰之吻，带来宁静。
lines.en: Frost's icy kiss, bringing peace.

lines.zh: 寒冷的寒冰之吻，冰霜怪的承诺。
lines.en: Cold icy kiss, frost's promise.

lines.zh: 寒冰之吻，冰霜怪的爱之语言。
lines.en: Icy kiss, frost's language of love.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪飞过雪地，寒风呼啸而过。
lines.en: Frost glides over the snow, cold winds howling.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片落下，冰封大地。
lines.en: Ice shards fall, freezing the land.
Ice stones shine with cold light.

lines.zh: 飘落的雪片中混着寒冰。
lines.en: Snowflakes carry ice shards.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪掠过冰封的湖面。
lines.en: Frost glides over the frozen lake.
Cold winds carry the frost scent.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片掉落，寒气逼人。
lines.en: Ice shards fall, cold and menacing.

lines.zh: 雪地里突然出现冰霜怪。
lines.en: Frost appears in the snow.

lines.zh: 寒冰石砸在地上，发出响声。
lines.en: Ice stones hit the ground, making a noise.

lines.zh: 飘雪中隐约可见冰霜怪。
lines.en: Snowflakes obscure Frost's form.
Frost fixes its gaze on the target.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪缓缓接近，寒气凝结。
lines.en: Frost approaches, condensing cold.
Ice shards fly toward the target.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪准备攻击，寒气逼人。
lines.en: Frost prepares to attack, cold and menacing.
Ice stones gather in its hand.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪锁定目标，寒气如刃。
lines.en: Frost locks on, cold like a blade.
Ice shards sparkle in the air.
Frost's eyes gleam with cold.

lines.zh: 寒冰石从冰霜怪手中飞出。
lines.en: Ice stones shoot from Frost's hand.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪锁定目标，准备出手。
lines.en: Frost targets, ready to strike.
It smells tomatoes on you.
A line of prints appears in the snow.
It climbs and swings behind you.

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片在它爪间凝出来。
lines.en: Ice shards form between its claws.

lines.zh: 它锁定了，雪原安静下来。
lines.en: It locks on. The snowfield goes quiet.

lines.zh: 冷气凝成白雾，贴地蔓延。
lines.en: Cold air pools into fog along the ground.
Frost extends its icy claws.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪准备攻击。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws prepare to strike.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪冻结了空气。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws freeze the air.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws gleam with cold.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪刺向敌人。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws pierce the enemy.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪冻结了目标。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws freeze the target.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪劈向目标。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws cleave toward the target.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪如刀般刺出。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws stab like blades.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪紧紧抓住目标。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws grasp the target tightly.

lines.zh: 冰霜怪的冰爪冻结了敌人。
lines.en: Frost's icy claws freeze the enemy.
It hovers, ice claws slowly spreading.
It fixes on the white mist of your breath.
Its ice feathers bristle upright.
It waits for you to move first.
The snow thickens. The wind shifts.

lines.zh: 它绕你半圈，找角度俯冲。
lines.en: It circles half around to line up a dive.
It gathers the cold under its wings.

lines.zh: 它停在你头顶，静静算距离。
lines.en: It stops overhead and quietly judges the distance.

lines.zh: 冰爪上凝出细细的霜刺。
lines.en: Fine frost spikes bead along its claws.

lines.zh: 它的影子落在你面前的雪上。
lines.en: Its shadow falls on the snow at your feet.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶！”，它张开大嘴准备攻击。
lines.en: Sssss! It opens its mouth to attack.
Frost roars in its mouth.
Cold breath comes over.
It extends its arms to attack.
Frost covers its claws.
It attacks with ice shards.
Coldness emanates from it.

lines.zh: 冰冷的触感让敌人颤抖。
lines.en: The cold touch makes enemies tremble.
Ice stone smashes the target.
It draws power from the ice.
Ice claws rake your shoulder!
It dives and hits your chest!
Freezing wind pours into your wound!

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片在你脚边炸开！
lines.en: Ice shards burst at your feet!

lines.zh: 它贴上你的背，冷得刺骨！
lines.en: It presses to your back, cold enough to sting!
An ice wing sweeps you off your feet!
It bites your arm and the cold spreads!
Frost spikes pierce your glove!
It clips you from the side and sends you stumbling!

lines.zh: 寒气顺着你的脖子往上爬！
lines.en: Cold crawls up your neck!
Snow plains frozen at night.
In the frozen cold wind.
In the snowy night.
A figure appears in the falling snow.
Frost glitters with a faint light.
Ground covered in ice crystals.
Frost spawns in the snow plains.
Ice crystals falling in the cold wind.
Shadows in the snowy depths.
In the frozen world.

lines.zh: 雪原上空传来冰裂的响声。
lines.en: Ice cracks somewhere above the snowfield.
A cold gust lifts white fog off the ground.
Frost doesn't fear fire!
I fell and it hurts!
Frozen drowning, too cold.
That explosion hurts!
That projectile hurts!
Your magic hurts me.
Starvation weakens me.
That lightning hurts!
Void hurts!
